title: [Autour de La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois, pages 1 à 67] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context: Grothendieck is setting up the dictionary behind the birational anabelian programme. Finitely generated fields K over Q are to be described by profinite data. Notation: k is the algebraic closure of Q in K, a number field. K̄ is an algebraic closure of K, and k̄ the closure of k inside K̄. The geometric group is π = π_{K̄/K} = π_1(K⊗_k k̄). The arithmetic group is Γ = Γ^{ar}_{K̄/K} = Gal(k̄/k). Together they form the extension 1 → π → E_{K̄/K} = Gal(K̄/K) → Γ → 1.

On the previous page he described the pair (K, K̄) by a triple (π, Γ, φ), with φ: Γ → Out(π) an outer action. This page starts by noting that the triple recovers E as the pullback of 1→π→Aut(π)→Out(π)→1 along φ. Strictly, that needs π to have trivial centre, which holds in the anabelian cases.

He then corrects himself. One must also give Γ as a subgroup of a definite Γ_{Q̄/Q}. Concretely: give an object Q̄ of the fundamental groupoid Π_Q, i.e. an algebraic closure of Q, together with a faithful action of Γ on it. That is an injective homomorphism Γ → Aut(Q̄) = Gal(Q̄/Q); its image is open because k/Q is finite. With this extra datum one reconstructs:
- a morphism of profinite groupoids Π_K → Π_Q plus an object of Π_K; or better,
- a morphism of 'pro-Galois' topoi (classifying topoi of profinite groups or groupoids) B_K → B_Q, where B_K is the étale topos of Spec K, plus a point of B_K.

A variant follows: fix only a point Q̄ of B_Q. Then study pairs (K, i), with i: k → Q̄ an embedding of the constant field, without choosing an algebraic closure K̄ inducing Q̄/Q. The description of these is completed on the next page: the outer group π_1(K⊗_k k̄) with an outer action of the open subgroup Γ_K = i^*Gal(Q̄/k) ⊂ Gal(Q̄/Q). That page also lists six 'essentially equivalent' viewpoints: topos over B_Q, groupoid over Π_Q, outer group over Γ_Q, and so on.

Purpose: to fix the right category (with base points or base-point-free) in which the functor K ↦ (profinite invariant over Γ_Q) should be fully faithful. This is Grothendieck's birational anabelian conjecture.
errors: Reconstructing E from (π, Γ, φ) as a pullback of Aut(π) → Out(π) only gives the extension up to the centre of π. It is canonical only when Z(π) = 1, which is true for the relevant anabelian π but is not stated here.
Minor: 'faithful action of Γ' on an object of Π_Q should be read as an injective homomorphism with open image. It is open automatically since k/Q is finite, but this is not said.

ideas.what: Describe a f.g. field K/Q by the fundamental extension 1→π_1(K⊗k̄)→Gal(K̄/K)→Gal(k̄/k)→1, i.e. by an outer Galois action on the geometric fundamental group
ideas.modern_name: fundamental exact sequence / outer Galois representation (birational anabelian setup)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck (Esquisse 1984, letter to Faltings 1983); developed by Ihara, Nakamura, Pop, Mochizuki
ideas.where_published: Letter to Faltings (1983); Esquisse d'un programme; La Longue Marche (1981)

ideas.what: Rigidify by embedding Γ_k as an open subgroup of a fixed Gal(Q̄/Q), equivalently a morphism of Galois topoi B_K → B_Q with a point, or of profinite fundamental groupoids Π_K → Π_Q
ideas.modern_name: fields as objects over Spec Q in the category of Galois categories/topoi; relative anabelian category over G_Q
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck; formalized in work on anabelian geometry (Pop, Mochizuki: 'over G_Q' isomorphisms)
ideas.where_published: Letter to Faltings; SGA1/SGA4 for Galois topoi and fundamental groupoids

ideas.what: Base-point-free variant: fix Q̄, consider pairs (K, i: k→Q̄) without choosing K̄
ideas.modern_name: outer-action formulation with open subgroup Γ_K ⊂ G_Q
ideas.where_published: Implicit in the letter to Faltings and the Esquisse

deep.surprise_reason: This is foundational bookkeeping: choices of base points and groupoid/topos formulations for the birational anabelian conjecture. All of it is in substance in the letter to Faltings and the Esquisse, and the conjecture itself was proved by Pop. No new result or connection appears.
transcription_corrections: 'pour reconstruire par l'ensemble[?] des données une base de groupoïdes profinis' — likely '... à l'aide de ces données une flèche de groupoïdes profinis Π_K → Π_Q' ('base' should be 'flèche').
'Γ^{ar}' — the superscript is 'ar' (arithmetic), consistent with Γ = Γ_{k̄/k}.
'clôture alg. de Q dans K' is correct; it refers to k.
